decisions.reason: The Abendbrotkäse was positioned as a flagship of the cheese range and has likely built a retail listing, though it has not been visible on the website since 2018 and a 2022 portfolio review could still remove it.
A basic semi-hard cheese wheel sits close to the core organic dairy offer and is a stable item for the cheese counter, so withdrawal is unlikely.
The mild creamy soft cheese appeals to mainstream taste and fits the range, but rising milk and energy costs in 2022 may prompt the firm to prune weaker cheese SKUs.
The washed-rind soft cheese is more niche and carries a higher delisting risk under 2022 cost pressure, but it adds variety to the specialty range and can stay for now.
